name: Quicker Login
description: Development-only module to log in as, or view any page as, any user by visiting a path or adding a ql= query parameter.
project_description:
The Quicker Login module is a DEVELOPER MODULE that once enabled allows you to view any page as any user or login as any user.

 Requirements 
 No special requirements. Only to be used during development and not on production.

 Install/Usage 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. 

 See: https://www.drupal.org/documentation/install/modules-themes/modules-8 

 To log in as any user, visit:

 /user/ql/{user_name} 

 To visit a page as any user e.g. the content listing, visit:

 /admin/content?ql={user_name} 

 Note: While the module is enabled. A warning message will be displayed on the site.
